FAQ's
Where can I find the nearest Asian Paints store?

You can use our store locator tool on the website to find the nearest Asian Paints store. Simply enter your location to get a list of nearby stores.
How can I contact Asian Paints customer service?

You can contact our customer service team by calling us on 1800-209-5678, or by emailing us directly at customercare@asianpaints.com. 
How do I choose the right colour for my home?

Consider factors such as the room’s lighting, furniture, and your personal style. You can also explore our Colour Catalogue and Home Colour Guide for ideas.
Can I get help with colour selection from Asian Paints?

Yes, our colour consultancy service is designed to help you choose the perfect shades for your home. 
What are the latest colour trends?

To know the latest colour trends you can go through the Asian Paints colour of the year or even talk to our experts to get the perfect paint colour for your home. 
How do I use the Asian Paints Colour Visualizer tool?

You can use the Asian Paints  Colour Visualizer tool allows by clicking a photo of your room and try out different paint colours. Follow the instructions on our app to see how various shades will look in your space.
Where can I find the paint calculator to estimate the amount of paint needed?

Our paint calculator is available on the website. Enter the dimensions of your room, and it will estimate the amount of paint required for your project.
How do I choose the right paint finish for my walls?

Different finishes suit different needs. For example, matte finishes hide imperfections, while glossy finishes are durable and easy to clean. Explore our Home Painting Guide on the website or consult with our experts for advice.
How can I book a colour consultancy session?

You can book a colour consultancy session through our website or by contacting our customer service team. We offer both online and in-person consultations at our stores.
How can I place an order for Asian Paints products?

Orders can be placed directly through our website, at an Asian Paints store, or by contacting our customer service team.
What is the delivery process for online orders?

Once you place an order, you will receive a confirmation email with delivery details. Our logistics team ensures timely and safe delivery of your products to your doorstep.
Can I track my order status?

Yes, you can track your order status through your account on our website. You will also receive updates via email and SMS regarding the progress of your delivery.
How do I prepare a surface for painting?

Proper surface preparation involves cleaning, sanding, and priming. Refer to our detailed guide on the website for step-by-step instructions to ensure a smooth and durable finish.
What is the best way to clean and maintain painted walls?

Regular dusting and occasional cleaning with a damp cloth can keep your painted walls looking fresh. 
How do I troubleshoot common painting issues (e.g., peeling, cracking)?

To address peeling or cracking paint, start by removing any loose or damaged paint with a scraper or sandpaper. Clean the area thoroughly, then apply a high-quality primer. Fill any deep cracks with putty and sand smooth. After priming, repaint with thin, even coats, allowing each layer to dry fully. Ensure you use quality products and prepare surfaces properly to prevent future issues. Control moisture by fixing leaks and managing humidity.
How can I stay updated on new products and offers?

Subscribe to our newsletter, follow us on social media, and regularly check our website to stay informed about the latest products, promotions, and offers from Asian Paints.
What warranty do Asian Paints products come with?

Asian Paints products come with a warranty, the specific terms and conditions vary by product and can be found on our website..
How do I claim a warranty or get support for a product issue?

To claim a warranty or get support, contact our customer service team with your purchase details and the nature of the issue. We will guide you through the process and provide the necessary assistance. You can also go through our warranty section on the website. 
What are the terms and conditions for product returns?

You can contact our customer service team or the dealer to understand the terms and conditions for a specific product return.

About Asian Paints

Your home is more than walls and rooms. It’s where life happens, where you laugh, dream, celebrate, and create memories that last forever. At Asian Paints, we understand how much your home means to you. That’s why, for over eighty years, we’ve been helping people across India bring their dream homes to life with colour, creativity, and care.

From the moment you decide to transform your living space, we are here to support you every step of the way. We begin with the essentials of painting a home, such as waterproofing your home to ensure its longevity and protection. Then, we help you select the perfect colors from our extensive range, guiding you through our Colour Inspiration Zone to find hues that reflect your personality and style. Finally, our interior design experts work with you to create a thorough plan that brings your vision to life. At Asian Paints, we are dedicated to turning your dreams into reality, creating a home that is not only beautiful but truly yours.

What started in 1942 as a small paint company has grown into India’s most loved home improvement brand. Today, we are trusted by millions of homeowners, painting contractors, and interior design experts. Our promise is simple: to make home painting and design an enjoyable experience filled with colour, comfort, and confidence.

Why is Asian Paints India’s Favourite Paint Brand?

Home is where your story begins, and every story deserves the right colours. That is why so many people across India choose Asian Paints. We understand colour, we understand design and most importantly, we understand what makes a house feel like home.

We have earned the trust of millions through quality, innovation and care. We bring you high-quality paints, reliable painting contractors, creative designers and expert support that ensure a smooth experience from start to finish.

Top Reasons to Choose Asian Paints for Your Home

 

Trusted Expertise in Home Painting and Interiors

Painting your home should feel exciting, not stressful. With Asian Paints, you can relax knowing that your project is in safe hands. 

We take pride in working with certified Painting Contractors, Waterproofing Contractors, and Carpenters who are trained and vetted by Asian Paints. Our experts use the latest tools, premium products, and modern techniques to deliver a superior finish every time.

  • Painting Contractors: Our team of trained painters ensures high-quality finishes, perfect color combinations, and zero mess. 

  • Waterproofing Contractors: Protect your home from dampness, leaks, and cracks with our advanced waterproofing solutions handled by certified professionals who diagnose and fix the root cause.

  • Carpenters and Interior Experts: Bring your design dreams to life with our skilled carpenters and interior specialists who craft functional, aesthetic furniture and fittings customized to your taste.

Wide Range of Products for Every Need

Every home is unique, which is why we offer a a complete range of paints, coatings, and finishes designed for Indian weather conditions, lifestyle needs, and design preferences.
 

Interior Wall Paints

Enhance the beauty of your home interiors with our rich palette of colors and textures:

  • Royale Glitz

  • Royale Aspira

  • Royale Shyne

  • Apcolite Premium Emulsion

  • Tractor Emulsion

  • Royale Play Textures

Each product is designed to give your walls a luxurious look with superior washability, stain resistance, and long-lasting shine.
 

Exterior Wall Paints

Your home’s exterior deserves the same care as your interiors. Our exterior paints are formulated to resist fading, cracking, and fungal growth, ensuring your home stays beautiful in every season:

  • Apex Ultima Protek

  • Apex Ultima Weatherproof Emulsion

  • Apex Floor Guard

  • Ace Exterior Emulsion

These paints provide UV protection, dirt resistance, and long-lasting color vibrancy.
 

Waterproofing Solutions

Asian Paints offers advanced waterproofing products that protect your home from leakage, dampness, and structural damage:

  • SmartCare Damp Proof

  • SmartCare Crack Seal

  • SmartCare Roof Guard

  • SmartCare Tile Grout

  • SmartCare Latex Plus

Our experts conduct a complete inspection before suggesting the most effective waterproofing system for your walls, roofs, and bathrooms.
 

Wood Finishes

Give your furniture the perfect polish and protection with our range of wood coatings and polishes:

  • Asian Paints Woodtech PU

  • Woodtech Melamyne

  • Woodtech Emporio PU

  • Woodtech Polish

These products enhance the natural beauty of wood while protecting it from stains, heat, and moisture.
 

Metal Finishes and Primers

Our specialized coatings for metals offer durability, corrosion resistance, and a rich finish

Sustainable and Safe Painting Solutions

Your home deserves products that are safe for your family and friendly to the environment. Many of our paints are low in VOCs, which means better air quality inside your home. Products like Asian Paints Royale Aspira is specially designed to keep your walls beautiful and your surroundings healthier. These paints come with anti-bacterial properties that make your home safer for your family. Our eco-friendly formulas and advanced technologies ensure you enjoy vibrant colour without compromising on safety.

Every product undergoes rigorous quality checks to ensure it meets the highest standards. When you choose Asian Paints, you are choosing paints that care for your home and for the planet.

Personalised Designs and Recommendations

Every home tells a different story. Our interior design experts help you bring your vision to life through personalised colour schemes and décor ideas that suit your taste and lifestyle.

Whether you're looking for modern wall colour combinations for your living room, new bathroom colour ideas, or a warm kitchen colour theme, we help you find what suits you best. Our designers take the time to understand your space and create solutions that are beautiful, comfortable and practical.

With Asian Paints, personalisation is not just about choosing colours. It is about creating spaces that make you feel at home every day.

Choose, Compare & Visualise Colours with Our Smart Paint Tools

Choosing the right paint colour is now simple and fun. Our smart tools let you browse thousands of shades, explore our colour shade card and visualise how each colour will look in your room before painting.

You can compare wall colour combinations and even estimate costs using our easy paint calculator. These tools help you make confident choices.

Planning a home makeover has never been easier. Try our color visualizer tool, experiment with colours and see your ideas come to life instantly.

Pan India Presence and Reliable Support

Wherever you live, Asian Paints is always nearby. With stores, service centres and trusted partners across India, you can easily find painting, waterproofing and interior design services in your area.

Our network of painting contractors, waterproofing experts and interior designers is always ready to assist. We make sure that every homeowner enjoys professional service, genuine products and quick support.

At Asian Paints, we are just a call or visit away whenever you need help with your home improvement project.

Home Improvement Services Offered by Asian Paints

We do more than paint. We help you build and maintain your dream home with services that combine beauty and practicality.
 

Wall Painting

Transform your home with professional wall painting. Choose from a wide range of interior and exterior paints in different shades and finishes. You can prefer subtle tones or bold colours, our team will help you create the look you want. Our painting contractors ensure clean, quick and high-quality work every time.
 

Waterproofing Solutions

Protect your home from moisture, cracks and seepage with our advanced waterproofing solutions. Our waterproofing contractors inspect problem areas and apply the right products to make sure your walls and roofs stay dry all year long.
 

Interior Design

From space planning to furniture selection, our interior design service helps you create rooms that are both stylish and practical. We work with you to select wall colours, décor elements and layouts that reflect your taste and personality.
 

Wallpaper Installation

Looking for a quick way to add personality to your room? Choose from a wide selection of wallpapers from Asian Paints’ Nilaya  collection, inspired by global design trends and crafted with precision. Our installation experts ensure a seamless finish and long-lasting adhesion. Explore themes ranging from modern minimalism to royal opulence and kids’ playful designs.

Instant Cost Estimation Tools for Painting, Waterproofing, Interior Design & Kitchen

We know that budgeting is an important part of every project. Our instant cost estimation tools make it easy to plan.

Use our paint calculator to estimate how much paint you need and how much it will cost. The waterproofing calculator helps you understand what products and services are right for your space. You can also check cost ranges for interior design and modular kitchen projects.

These tools are designed to help you plan smartly, compare options and make decisions confidently before starting your project.

Find Stores Offering Painting, Waterproofing & Interior Services Near You

With thousands of Asian Paints dealers, Color Ideas stores, and service centers across India, professional assistance is never far away. Use our Store Locator Tool to find nearby outlets offering:

  • Paint products

  • Painting and waterproofing services

  • Wallpaper, wood finish, and décor products

  • Expert consultation and color advice

Our stores also showcase sample finishes, texture walls, and color palettes so you can experience our products firsthand before making a choice.

At Asian Paints, we believe your home deserves the best colours, the best protection and the best care. With trusted products, skilled professionals and a passion for perfection, we make sure every home we touch becomes a little more special.

Let us bring colour, warmth and inspiration to your home. Let us paint your story together.


About Asian Paints

 

Creating a home out of a space is a beautiful journey, and at Asian Paints, we are honored to take that journey with you. From the moment you decide to transform your living space, we are here to support you every step of the way. We begin with the essentials of painting a home, such as waterproofing your home to ensure its longevity and protection. Then, we help you select the perfect colors from our extensive range, guiding you through our Colour Inspiration Zone to find hues that reflect your personality and style. Finally, our interior design experts work with you to create a thorough plan that brings your vision to life. At Asian Paints, we are dedicated to turning your dreams into reality, creating a home that is not only beautiful but truly yours.

Privacy Preference Center

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change our default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.

Manage Consent Preferences

Functional Cookies

These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Targeting Cookies

These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

Social Media Cookies

These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit. If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools.
